rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.7, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-1 ONBOARDING/FEASIBILITY fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained (per-image few-step DC-CONSTRAINED Haar-wavelet flow recon, solver_fast_recon.py) on re-split Breast-CT (train 3600 / val 200 / test 200, seed 20260703), val_n=200. Prior ckpt = MAYO-TRAINED fast_diffusion_wavelet_constrained.pt (domain=wavelet mode=constrained ch=64 fd_out_scale=0.05 val_flow_loss=0.0174) -- NO breast-native wavelet prior exists, so this is the documented Mayo-prior fallback; breast mu ranges to ~0.5 (10x Mayo's ~0.05 out_scale normaliser) so a domain-normalisation mismatch is EXPECTED and the DC-step is what anchors HU. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: none for this slug; nearest ref = Mayo fastdiff-wdm-wavelet-CONSTRAINED search-20260620-01 (all 20 iters hr=0, regime-bound below the 2304-view dense-Mayo FBP floor; its best converged at steps16/init_t0.4/dc_relax1.0, SSIM~0.915 RMSE~1.23e-3). Its constrained sibling curve showed lower init_t + full dc_relax was the RMSE-down direction. Breast is the OPPOSITE regime: 128-view SPARSE, where the wavelet prior + hard CG DC-step is designed to help MOST (data under-constrains, the prior fills the null space and DC pins the measured rays). (2) FAILURE MODE: N/A onboarding; goal = does the DC-constrained wavelet recon RUN on breast 128-view 512^2 val=200 under the HARD 20-min budget and where does it sit vs the sparse-view FBP baseline (breast LD-FBP baseline_PSNR ~36.3)? (3) ONE KNOB: N/A baseline -- canonical fast_recon constrained recon defaults (8-step Euler, FBP init t=0.7, eta=1.0, DC on, CG=5, relax=0.5), identical to the Mayo constrained iter-1 and the breast pixel/wavelet siblings' iter-1, so this iter is a clean cross-solver anchor. (4) HYPOTHESIS: an 8-step DC-constrained wavelet flow with the Mayo wavelet prior + full 128-view CG data-consistency clears the sparse-view breast FBP baseline (hr>0) because the hard CG DC-step anchors the recon to the measured sparse sinogram while the wavelet prior suppresses streaks in the angular null space; the 10x out_scale mismatch mainly weakens the prior term, which the DC-step compensates. FALSIFIER: if hr=0 despite the sparse regime, the out_scale mismatch is corrupting HU faster than DC recovers -> iter-2 raises fd_recon_dc_relax to 1.0 (full DC) and/or lowers fd_recon_init_t (start closer to FBP, less prior drift), the proven Mayo-constrained RMSE-down direction. (5) BUDGET: 200 slices x 8-step Euler + 5-iter CG each, breast single shared PYRO-NN projector (no per-sample-ps swap), 512^2. Mayo wdm-wavelet constrained at 214 slices/8 steps ran ~380-560s; breast (128 views, smaller det arc, same steps) fits well inside the HARD 20-min budget (30-min sbatch wall, 1800s in-solver kill). val = ALL 200 fixed seed-20260703 val cases (do NOT reduce). (6) Loop continues; iter-2 self-dispatched on landing. Reserved levers iters 2-20: fd_recon_dc_relax (DC strength), fd_recon_init_t (prior drift), fd_recon_steps (NFE), fd_recon_eta (DPS guidance).
